description: Which refgrid cell is compared with which rectangle of the kit's state atlas. reference: a cell id from refgrid/cells.def, or a measured part from refgrid's report (menu.item3, tab.item0, menubar.item1). atlas: a key from atlas-cells.json. compare: exact = every pixel (sizes must match); ring = the outer `ring` pixels only, so a text label inside does not count; profile = only the edge colours inward from the middle of each side and from two corners, for pairs whose sizes differ by design. atlasGrow [left, top, right, bottom] widens the kit's rectangle to take in lines drawn just outside its box. referencePart [dx, dy, w, h] narrows the reference to part of its rectangle. Cells on either side that are not listed here are reported as unmapped, not forced into a match.
